name: pre-delivery-meeple-v1
description: ⭐ THE reference-v18 GAME, KEPT AS A CONTROL (14/09/2026). The shipped game as it stood at commit f0a0658, the day Dean ruled the Apiary retext in, BEFORE he ruled the delivery meeple ON and added the space choice and the closing draw. Six leaves, all pinned BY NAME at their pre-ruling values: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null and meepleSpendDistinctColours false (⛔ 'start' and null are the old INERT values, not the 'none' and 0 of section 3 of docs/village-store-coins-handoff-2026-09-12-v1.md, which would delete the v31 control's turn-start spend), rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice false (fill order: 6 VP to the first arrival, 3 VP to the second) and rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 0 (no draw for filling a tile). ⭐ IT IS THE ZERO-DIFF PROOF OF THE SLICE: a --watchlist --n=1580 run of this overlay must reproduce reports/watchlist-2026-09-14T14-42-22-reference-v18.txt on every measured line, and only header, timestamp and wall-clock lines may differ. ⭐ THE THREE DECOMPOSITION ARMS ON THE NEW BASE read against it: overlays/delivery-meeple-no-choice-v1.overlay.json (the meeple alone), overlays/delivery-meeple-choice-v1.overlay.json (the meeple and the space choice) and overlays/closing-draw-only-v1.overlay.json (the closing draw alone); the shipped default is all three together. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors), paired on identical reference-v18 seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level. ⛔ HAND LIMIT PINNED 24/09/2026: the simulator's hand bound moved from 7 to 10 (rules.turn.handLimit is an INSTRUMENT bound, never a table rule, CLAUDE.md 2.3; the move is reasoned in rules.json's meta.notes). This overlay predates that move and replays a game recorded under the bound of 7, so rules.turn.handLimit 7 is pinned here BY NAME and it still replays its own game.
